lines.zh: 我扇两下翅膀，就落在一朵花上。
lines.en: Two wingbeats and I'm on a flower.
Flying by day, sun on my wings.
A big plain, flowers in patches.

lines.zh: 我的翅是橙色的，边上带黑。
lines.en: My wings are orange, edged in black.
Not fast. But I go far.
I swing around a cow and fly on.
When the wind picks up, I drop close to the grass.

lines.zh: 我沿着花丛飞，一路过去。
lines.en: I follow the flower line the whole way.

lines.zh: 这一片虞美人，开得正好。
lines.en: These poppies are at their best.
I stop. Then fly. Then stop.

lines.zh: 我的翅上有粉，看起来很白。
lines.en: Pollen dusts my wings white.

lines.zh: 我飞过小溪，翅上沾了水。
lines.en: I cross a stream and my wings catch water.
Not a long way. I take it easy.

lines.zh: 我在草地上画了一道橙。
lines.en: I draw an orange line over the grass.
Bees over there. I go around.

lines.zh: 我停在叶子上晾了晾翅。
lines.en: I settle on a leaf and dry my wings.

lines.zh: 我合起翅，橙色的那面藏了。
lines.en: I fold my wings and the orange hides.
I'm on a flower, drinking slowly.

lines.zh: 白天热，我躲在叶子下面。
lines.en: The day's hot. I shelter under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我的翅合起来，像一片枯叶。
lines.en: Folded, my wings look like a dead leaf.

lines.zh: 我合着翅，黑边里透出橙。
lines.en: Wings closed, orange shows through the black edge.
A petal on the ground. Fallen.

lines.zh: 我扇了扇，把身上的粉抖开。
lines.en: I flap once to shake the pollen loose.
I've memorized the flowers here.
A bird passes. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我尝起来不好吃，它们知道。
lines.en: I taste bad. They know it.
The flowers are still open. No rush.

lines.zh: 这一片平原，比林子舒服。
lines.en: This plain suits me better than the forest.
You're blocking the sun.
I land on the flower by your hand.

lines.zh: 你这么大，我一动就能跑。
lines.en: You're big. One flap and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我抬起翅，让你看清颜色。
lines.en: I lift my wings so you see the colour.
Looking at me? Then I'll look back.

lines.zh: 你肩后的阳光替我描了边。
lines.en: The sun behind your shoulder traces my outline.
Don't grab me. My wings are fragile.

lines.zh: 我在你帽檐上停了一下。
lines.en: I rest for a moment on your hat brim.
Your hands don't smell of flowers.

lines.zh: 我一动，橙色的那面就露出来。
lines.en: One movement and the orange shows.

lines.zh: 我翅上破了一点，还能飞。
lines.en: A nick in my wing. I can still fly.
I settle and rest a moment.

lines.zh: 触角折了一截，方向乱了。
lines.en: One antenna is bent; my sense of direction blurs.
That knocked the pollen off.
Half a circle to steady myself.
The wing membrane is crumpled; I lick it flat.
A split on the wing edge. It'll do.
I'm flying much lower now.

lines.zh: 我停在虞美人上，别惊我。
lines.en: On a poppy, don't startle me.
A little sun will mend this.
Poppies. I know that red.
I settle and take a sip.
This one's newly opened. Sweet.
I drink slowly so the petals aren't bruised.

lines.zh: 粉沾在我腿上，正好带走。
lines.en: Pollen on my legs. It'll travel with me.
You hold it up; I circle it.
Not enough. I'll find more.
Don't pick it. It won't open again.
I stayed on this one a long while.

lines.zh: 这个味道，我飞了两格才找到。
lines.en: That smell took me two blocks to find.

lines.zh: 我撞在草叶上，弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit a blade of grass and bounce.
A wing got knocked. I fly crooked.
I settled on a poppy for a moment.

lines.zh: 这一下，把花粉都抖掉了。
lines.en: That shook off all the pollen.
I go around you and land back on the flower.
Don't wave your hands by the flowers.
I hover and steady myself.

lines.zh: 虞美人的花蜜，我认得路。
lines.en: I know the way to the poppy nectar.

lines.zh: 虞美人被我撞歪，花瓣落了。
lines.en: I knocked the poppy askew; petals fall.
I rest on your arm to catch myself.
I circle above the flowers.

lines.zh: 另一只也绕起来，跟着我。
lines.en: Another joins the circle, following me.

lines.zh: 我们上下翻飞，翅都碰到。
lines.en: We tumble up and down, wings touching.
This is brief. Done by daylight's end.

lines.zh: 虞美人的红，跟我翅膀一个色。
lines.en: The poppies are the same red as my wings.

lines.zh: 叶子上，就留着我的后代。
lines.en: The leaf will hold my young.

lines.zh: 我们都飞走了，各飞各的。
lines.en: We both fly off. Separate ways.
The flowers remain. We're gone.
Only sun and wind in this part.

lines.zh: 我记住了它翅上的黑边。
lines.en: I remember the black edge on its wings.
I land on the petal and sip.
Not edible. I fly off.
I scrape a little pollen with my legs.
Too smooth. I can't stand on it.

lines.zh: 我用腿刮下花粉，装进篮里。
lines.en: I scrape pollen into the baskets on my legs.
I shake it onto another flower.
Wrong smell. Not this.
I pause, then fly off.
The flower's still open. Tomorrow, then.
I carry it two blocks.
That red. I see it.
I raise my wings and hover.
One block. One wingbeat.
Someone's by the flower. Go around.
My antennae reach out first.
This one's at its best. That's the one.
Wind from behind. Perfect.

lines.zh: 那朵红罂粟的花蜜我认得。
lines.en: I know the nectar of that red poppy.

lines.zh: 我先落在叶上，再飞跃过去。
lines.en: I land on a leaf first, then hop across.
So many. I'll pick one.
I fly straight at that red.
Shift a little. I want to land.
I hover above the flower, waiting for the wind.
I descend slowly, wings still beating.

lines.zh: 这朵花里有蜜，我闻到了。
lines.en: Nectar in this flower. I smell it.
I circle it, looking for an angle.
Come closer and I'll leave.
I land on the petal's edge. Lightly.
Right there — I can reach the stamen.
The sun's turning. I won't wait.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下，只有一点力。
lines.en: I bump into it. Very little force.
My wing sweeps past, stirring air.
That scattered pollen.
I don't bite. I can't.

lines.zh: 我的翅粉有毒，你揉进了眼。
lines.en: My wing dust is poison, and you rubbed it into your eye.
I hit and leave without looking back.

lines.zh: 我拍了一下你的鼻尖就走。
lines.en: I tap your nose once and leave.
That knocked me off balance too.
I go around you, back to the flower.
Anyone who eats me will regret it.

lines.zh: 我从叶背上出来，翅还是软的。
lines.en: I come off the leaf's underside, wings still soft.
Day's just breaking. I bask my wings first.
The orange slowly shows.

lines.zh: 平原上的花，我一片片找。
lines.en: I search the plain's flowers patch by patch.

lines.zh: 我落在最近的虞美人上。
lines.en: I land on the nearest poppy.
One beat and the grass stirs.
More open here than I expected.
First, my bearings.

lines.zh: 我的黑边在阳光下很清楚。
lines.en: My black edge shows clearly in the sun.
I dry my wings before flying.

lines.zh: 火一近，翅边就卷起来了。
lines.en: Fire comes near and my wing edges curl.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下，摔在草里。
lines.en: I drop out of the air into the grass.
Water clogs my wings. I can't lift.
The blast blows me far.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过翅，留了个洞。
lines.en: Something passed through my wing. A hole.
Light covers me and my wings burn.

lines.zh: 好几天没花蜜，我没力气。
lines.en: Days without nectar. No strength.

lines.zh: 雷照亮整片平原，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Lightning lights the plain and I can't see.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我扇不动翅。
lines.en: Emptiness below and my wings won't beat.
